verdict.rationale: Refund and credit-note handling is a fair axis for a sales-tax calculation and filing product, but the evidence pack never mentions refunds, credit notes or negative-amount transactions. It covers only generic transaction upload (createOrder) and AutoFile moving state reports into returns. Those are adjacent features and earn no credit for refunds flowing through liability, reporting and the next filing.

support.subject: As a developer, refunds and credit notes adjust tax correctly — negative amounts flow through liability, reporting, and the next filing without manual journal fixes
